notes:
Retoob TV 0.5.3 preview 1

Fix scrolling lag when holding Right on the Latest videos Home shelf. Home now reuses its shelf data during focus and preview saves instead of repeatedly rebuilding every shelf and rescanning feed dates.

Home constructs only the newest 20 unique combined cards with a per-feed cursor merge. View all expands to the newest 500 only when opened, while retaining every selected video’s source mentions.

Cold-start previews, newly loaded feed content, hidden-feed changes and withdrawals still update the shelves correctly. Existing feed order, subscriptions, hidden choices, Family pairing and playback behavior are preserved.

Isolated test builds are clearly labelled and cannot offer incompatible production updates. Use the regular Retoob app for the signed release channel.

Both build variants pass 148 unit tests and Android lint. A short physical-TV diagnostic showed shorter input-to-focus-draw times on Latest videos; broad device/performance verification remains ongoing.

Install over the existing signed preview without uninstalling.
